proof_status: Exploratory empirical studies with source-bound independent LLM audit, not accepted general theorems
scope_limits: The pilot is one initialization and 200 updates per condition. Nonuniform learned pooling did not demonstrate useful positional protection; that failure does not prove inability of the architecture or fixed-half readout.

Finite CE-selected proposals are legal word-derived edits preserving terminal bits, not the full Hamming ball or source-TV maximizers. Each predictor chooses its own attack; paired clean words need not yield identical corrupted inputs. A has infinite-CE ties. Post-hoc true-source comparisons are diagnostics, never authority to use the hidden source for attack selection.

The random frozen control is near uniform. Uniform-profile ablation changes features and attack selection and can induce distribution shift; it is not isolated causal proof. Finite-panel maxima and pointwise standard errors are not general-source bounds or simultaneous confidence intervals.

Calibration explicitly supervises Q with fixed positional features and oversampled supplied collision words. It has no attacks and is not natural next-token feature discovery. Count-scaled and normalized representations share the same fixed-M function class and initial function, but Adam is parameterization-sensitive.

Three calibration initializations share the same datasets and minibatch stream. Independently sampled training/validation sets have 9 overlapping distinct words, accounting for 25 validation trajectories; collision checks reuse four supplied training words. They are not independent data replications or unseen-collision generalization.

All scaled fits pass a finite average/in-sample screen, yet maximum held-out absolute errors remain 0.401–0.434, with 13–14 of 2,048 errors above 0.1 per fit. No small uniform approximation, minimax robustness or general statistical learning guarantee follows.

Original reports, earlier design budgets and pending-review language remain chronological records. Additive review amendments and current publication navigation govern interpretation; no historical report or numerical result was overwritten.

The publisher verified identities, privacy, code syntax, source resolution and numeric-array schemas without rerunning training or scientific audits. Source reports record their actual independent replays; these are not external peer review, formal verification, preregistration or trusted external timestamps.

All prior published bytes, including the 55-page manuscript, remain unchanged except five navigation pages and the active inventory. No new license, workflow, permissions, credentials or deployment. Prior missing-history boundaries are not enlarged or falsely resolved.
